title: Archive research: Nixon could slip his security

tellings.quote: >> So and and Nixon we had heard these stories like they said, oh he couldn't get away from his security. So I checked it and sure enough he got away from his security lots of times.

plain: A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron says people used to claim Richard Nixon, US president from 1969 to 1974, could never get away from his security guards. Cameron says he checked Nixon's records at the National Archives, where the US government keeps its official papers, and found Nixon slipped his security many times, including around his Florida home at Key Biscayne. That would leave room for the stories of him going places unseen.
